name: holdout_telehealth
description: Holdout: appointment, video, prescription, and payment workflow.
resource_constraints_text: Deploy Docker containers on Azure Linux VMs in Korea Central. The monthly budget is 900 USD. Service interruption during one VM failure shall not prevent appointment booking.

classified.text: Patients browse clinician availability and book an open appointment slot.
Clinicians publish working hours and block unavailable periods.
Patients and clinicians join an appointment using a session created by the external Video Service.
Clinicians record consultation notes in the patient's visit history.
Clinicians issue a prescription that the system transmits to the Pharmacy selected by the patient.
Patients pay a consultation invoice through the external Payment Gateway.
Patients receive an appointment reminder 24 hours before the scheduled start.
Compliance auditors review access records for patient information.
Booking shall prevent two patients from reserving the same appointment slot.
Clinical and appointment records shall survive container and VM restarts.
Patient information shall be encrypted in transit and at rest.
Patient-record access shall produce immutable audit records retained for seven years.
The booking API shall respond within two seconds at the 95th percentile under 30 requests per second.
The application shall run as Docker containers on Linux VMs and expose health metrics.
